summary: MVP for "Auntie Maia"; booking is for parent tours/enrollment interviews and is separate from the nanny-cam livestream. User requested implementing a functional booking flow.
architectural_notes: Booking system (tours/enrollment interviews) is independent from the nanny-cam livestream; no linkage required by default.
known_issues: Current MVP booking action/button is not wired up (no submission/confirmation/storage), so parents get no response when trying to book.

existing_features.title: Require Internet Identity sign-in for the Tours/Interviews booking page so that booking submission and viewing stored requests cannot fail silently due to missing authorization.
Fix the booking confirmation modal so it reliably appears after a successful submission and displays the correct submitted date/time, details, and booking ID.

Add a simple booking details form that collects parent contact information (name and email at minimum) along with optional notes, and ensure the submitted information is persisted with the booking request.
Provide clear user-facing error feedback if booking submission fails (e.g., network/authorization issues), instead of only logging to the console.
Ensure submitted bookings are stored and viewable from the UI by listing the signed-in user's tour requests on the /tours page and keeping the list up-to-date after creating a new request.

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement booking flow for parent tours and enrollment interviews (form submission + confirmation + stored/viewable bookings for Auntie Maia)
